widthMode.label: Width
widthMode.fluidDescription: Absorbs the design's extra width. Gaps in line with this element become fixed width.
widthMode.proportionalDescription: Fixed width. Maintains its position relative to the left and right edges.

heightMode.label: Height
heightMode.fluidDescription: Absorbs the design's extra height. Gaps in line with this element become fixed height.
heightMode.proportionalDescription: Fixed height. Maintains its position relative to the top and bottom edges.

edge.left: Fixed width. Pin to the left edge.
edge.right: Fixed width. Pin to the right edge.
edge.top: Fixed height. Pin to the top edge.
edge.bottom: Fixed height. Pin to the bottom edge.

element.left: Fixed width. Pin to the closest neighbour on the left.
element.right: Fixed width. Pin to the closest neighbour on the right.
element.top: Fixed height. Pin to the closest neighbour above.
element.bottom: Fixed height. Pin to the closest neighbour below.

property.label: Property
property.description: Fills the element with the value of a property.

content.label: Static content
content.description: Shown when the element has no property, or its property has no value.
